en.headline: Public secondary schools lose four S1 classes after headcount
en.dek: The Education Bureau said no public secondary school fell below two classes in Secondary One, Two or Four, so none must apply for a development plan this year.
body: The Education Bureau said public secondary schools will operate four fewer Secondary One classes this academic year after the September headcount of pupils actually in school, while primary one class numbers were unchanged.

Officials counted pupils on 15 September and checked figures submitted through the electronic system. Letters went out on Monday telling schools that must adjust their approved class structure and staffing for 2026-27. Compared with the class totals approved in the earlier allocation letters, secondary schools lost four Secondary One classes in all; primary schools saw no change at Primary One.

The bureau said no public secondary school had only one approved class in Secondary One, Two or Four, so none must apply for a development plan — the step that can lead to closure. Eight primary schools that received no Primary One class had already applied to merge with eight other schools, the bureau said, without naming them.

A pilot scheme allowing eligible secondary schools to apply to run five Secondary One classes instead of four remains open until 15 October, with a cap of five schools this year. The bureau said it would weigh overall supply and demand, local conditions, facilities, school records and parental preference, and that previous applications would not count for or against a school.

zh.headline: 點人頭後公營中學減四班中一 沒有學校陷殺校程序
zh.dek: 教育局公布本學年公營中學經九月點算後共減四班中一，小學小一班數不變，亦沒有中學因不足兩班而須申請發展方案。
body: 教育局表示，經九月點算實際在學人數後，本學年公營中學的中一核准班數較早前開班信所批核的總數減少四班，公營小學的小一班數則維持不變。
當局於九月十五日派員到部分學校實地點算，並核實學校經電子系統遞交的學生資料，其後於星期一發信，通知須調整二零二六至二七學年班級結構及教職員編制的學校。
局方指，本學年沒有公營中學的核准中一、中二或中四班數僅餘一班，因此沒有學校須申請發展方案，亦即沒有學校因而踏入殺校程序。小學方面，獲派零班小一的學校數目維持不變，當中有八所已申請與另外八所學校合併，局方未有公布校名。
教育局繼續推行先導計劃，容許合資格中學申請中一「四班變五班」，申請下月十五日截止，本學年限額最多五間。當局會整體考慮學額供求、地區情況、校舍設施、辦學往績及家長意願，並表明以往曾否申請不在考慮之列。
